points: Early production on the former Model S/X line in Fremont, designed for one million robots a year
Musk: about 20,000 a week will take at least a year; external deliveries around end of 2027
Open problems named on the call: hands, custom gears, durability and lack of a data-collecting fleet
read: Electrek report on Tesla's Q3 2026 shareholder letter and earnings call, 22 Oct 2026
take: Tesla claims its first production-quality humanoids but says hands and durability are unsolved. Plan humanoid pilots for 2028 or later, not next year.
title: Tesla: Optimus production starts, outside deliveries not before late 2027
